{{Top|leg}}
The '''South Conical Mountains''' were an arrangement of seven cones&mdash;six small cones surrounding a large, center cone &mdash; situated at one end of [[Centerpoint Station]]'s [[Hollowtown]]. It was believed that this unusual geometric array of cones generated the power needed to operate the powerful [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] of [[Centerpoint Station]], as it resembled ancient devices of a similar nature. The largest cone was often referred to as the '''South Conical Mountain'''.<ref name="SAC">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref> One of the smaller cones was known as [[Conical Six]], and was owned by the [[Five Brothers Resort and Casino]].<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
